trigger: creator rejected v1 as not story-connected

diagnosis.v1_failure: The draft stated a thesis instead of telling a story. It had no wound, no consequence, and no repair.
diagnosis.repair_principle: Start with a missed bid and make the emotional cost visible before the tender turn.
diagnosis.ig_connection_logic: A strong carousel needs a first-slide open loop, a recognizable tiny conflict, a visible consequence, and a final line people want to send as repair.

repaired_story.title: The Third Dekh Na
repaired_story.emotional_machine: tiny bid missed twice -> third bid disappears -> partner notices silence -> repair invitation
repaired_story.why_it_connects: Most couples recognize both sides: asking someone to enter a tiny moment, and realizing too late that your 'hmm' made them stop asking.

repaired_slide_copy: So she kept it to herself.
